findings.issue: לַמָּסָךְ is a common noun (H4539), not a proper name; masaj leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
שִׁטִּים is a common noun (H7848), not a locked proper name; shitím Hebraizes it instead of Spanish.

notes: Verbs, five, columns, overlay them gold, their hooks gold, and cast for them five bronze bases match the tokens.
